title: Catheter Robot Atlas: robot record
description: One endovascular catheter or guidewire robot (all versions of one robot line in one record). Free-text fields keep the wording of the sources; 'N.R.' means the sources read do not report it. Fields marked derived are computed from the free text by tools/build_site.py while the CSV is the source of truth.

id.description: <shortname>_<firstauthor or company><year>, lower case; also the file name and the page URL (robots/<id>.html).

name.description: Short display name used on cards.

full_name.description: Full name as the sources give it, with a short description.

group.description: Developer: laboratory, university or company, with clinical partners where stated.

group_short.description: Short form of the developer for cards.

family.description: One of four families used across the atlas.

x-definitions.commercial: Products and clinical-stage systems from companies, including commercial magnetic systems.
x-definitions.academic: Research robots at the bedside that push and twist catheters and guidewires.
x-definitions.tip: Devices whose own tip bends (tendons, shape-memory alloy, fluid, notched tubes), with or without a bedside drive.
x-definitions.magnetic: Academic systems that steer a magnetic device tip with an external field.

category.description: Finer category of the search briefs; family groups these.

x-definitions.clinical-stage: Company system in or near clinical trials.
x-definitions.actuated-device: A device that actuates its own tip.

first_year.description: Year of the first publication or product of this robot line; null when not reported.

latest_year.description: Year of the latest version found.

versions.description: Lineage of versions with their papers (oldest first).

devices.description: Device types the robot drives (derived from devices_driven by keyword; the free text is authoritative).

x-definitions.guidewire: Guidewire or microwire (including a robot's own wire).
x-definitions.catheter: Guide, diagnostic, aspiration, ablation, imaging or steerable catheter.
x-definitions.therapeutic-device: Balloon, stent, stent retriever, coil, clip or valve delivery system.
x-definitions.other: Own untethered or soft robot, or an unspecified instrument.

devices_driven.description: Which devices, sizes and how many at once, as the sources state.
examples: guidewire 0.014 in; 2.8 Fr microcatheter; 6 Fr aspiration catheter

n_dof.description: Number of actuated degrees of freedom (the leading number of n_dof_detail); null when not stated as a number.

n_dof_detail.description: Degrees of freedom as the sources state them.

translation_mechanism.description: How the robot pushes and pulls the device.

x-definitions.friction-roller: A pair of wheels pinches the device and turns to push it; unlimited stroke.
x-definitions.clamp-relay: Grippers alternately clamp and move, hand over hand.
x-definitions.belt/track: Two belts or tracks squeeze the device.
x-definitions.linear-stage+clamp: One clamp rides a carriage on a rail or lead screw; stroke = rail length.
x-definitions.magnetic: The tip is steered by an external field; a separate feeder may push.
x-definitions.tendon/tip-actuation: The device bends itself (tendons, SMA, fluid).
x-definitions.other: Hybrid or other drive; see translation_detail.
x-definitions.not-reported: Not reported in the sources read.

translation_detail.description: Translation mechanism in the sources' words.

rotation_mechanism.description: How the robot twists the device about its own axis (derived from rotation_detail by keyword with reviewed exceptions while the CSV is the source of truth).

x-definitions.rotating-clamp: A clamp, gripper, chuck or torque device holds the device and turns with it.
x-definitions.rotating-drive-unit: The whole roller pair, cassette or frame turns about the device axis.
x-definitions.roller-rolling: Rollers or pads move across each other and roll the device between them, like thumb and forefinger.
x-definitions.handle-rotation: Motors turn a catheter handle or its steering knobs.
x-definitions.tendon-bending: No shaft rotation; the tip bends by tendons.
x-definitions.magnetic-field: No shaft rotation; the tip direction follows an external field.
x-definitions.none: No rotation degree of freedom, or rotation by hand.
x-definitions.other: Actuated, but the mechanism fits none of the classes above or is described only as 'a motor'.
x-definitions.not-reported: Not reported in the sources read.

rotation_detail.description: Rotation mechanism in the sources' words.

footprint_mm.description: Size of the bedside unit in mm as reported.

force_sensing.description: Force or torque sensing: where, how, accuracy.

imaging_compat.description: Imaging the robot works with (fluoroscopy, MRI, ultrasound) and radiation-related design.

sterility.description: Sterile barrier, cassette or disposable concept.

highest_validation.description: Highest level at which the robot was tested.

x-definitions.bench: Device driven on the bench (in air, in a straight tube); accuracy tests.

validation_detail.description: What was tested, how often, with whom.

key_numbers.description: Headline performance numbers with their sources.

sim_model.description: Published simulation model of this robot or its devices (simulator, paper), or 'none found'.

has_sim_model.description: Derived: sim_model names a model (does not start with none, no or N.R.).

sim2real.description: Has a controller or model trained in simulation run on this robot?

x-definitions.yes: A controller or perception model trained in simulation ran on this robot.
x-definitions.partial: A simulation-trained part ran on the robot at motor level only, not for navigation.
x-definitions.model-based: Commands computed in a simulator or from a physical model ran on the robot; nothing was learned.
x-definitions.unclear: Learning or simulation is reported but where it was trained is not stated.
x-definitions.none-found: No simulation-trained controller found for this robot.

sim2real_detail.description: The study, its level and its numbers.

picture.description: The best picture of the robot found. Only pictures whose licence allows reuse (CC BY without NC/ND/SA, or the maintainers' own material) are published; the others are described and linked to their source.

status.description: cleared = licence allows reuse and the picture is shown; not-cleared = a picture exists at the source; none = no picture found.

x-definitions.cleared: Licence allows reuse with credit; shown on the public site.
x-definitions.not-cleared: A picture exists but its licence does not allow reuse; the site links to the source.

grade.description: Quality of the best picture found.

x-definitions.A: Clean, sharp, whole robot; good printed 2 in wide.
x-definitions.B: Usable with one flaw (small, clutter at the edge, CAD only, partly hidden).
x-definitions.C: Best available is still annotated, tiny or partial.

source.description: Where the picture comes from: paper key and figure, or page URL.

source_url.description: Link to the picture's source (DOI, arXiv or web page).

licence.description: Licence as stated by the source.

credit.description: Attribution line shown under a cleared picture.

edits.description: Changes made to the picture (cropping, erased labels); CC BY asks for these to be indicated.

file.description: Web-size copy (long side 800 px) in pictures/; present only when status is cleared.

pictures.description: Further pictures of the robot from its papers or its maker (the gallery on its page), best first. Like the main picture, only cleared pictures are published; the others are described and linked to their source.

status.description: cleared = licence allows reuse (shown on the public site); not-cleared = linked only.

file.description: Web copy, long side 1200 px; only when cleared.

thumb.description: Thumbnail, long side 360 px; only when cleared.

x-definitions.render: CAD render or drawing of the robot.
x-definitions.in-use: The robot in use (bench, phantom, animal, clinical).
x-definitions.close-up: A drive, cassette or module close up.
x-definitions.setup: The experimental set-up around the robot.

source_key.description: BibTeX key of the paper, or web:<site> for a company or press page.

source.description: Attribution: authors, venue (year), figure and page.

source_url.description: Link to the source (DOI, arXiv or page).

where.description: Figure and page in the source, or the image URL.

licence.description: Licence as stated by the source.

sources.description: Papers and pages the record is built from, oldest first where known.

url.description: Link when there is no DOI.

x-definitions.partial: Parts of the full text read.

read_level_detail.description: Which source was read at which level.

notes.description: Anything that does not fit the fields above.

maintainers_own.description: True for the robots built by the lab that maintains this catalogue (conflict of interest, stated once on the About page; not marked on the site).

found_by.description: Which logged search added the record.

x-definitions.commercial: Search of commercial and clinical-stage systems.
x-definitions.actuated-tip: Search of actuated-tip and magnetic devices.
x-definitions.gap: Gap searches for robots the other searches missed.
x-definitions.contributor: Added by a contributor through a pull request.

x-internal-note: Fields with x-internal: true (simulation and sim-to-real) stay in-house: the public build and the public repository leave them out.
